Real DB untouched (0 question records, 0 Chapter-names audits, only the two older isolated databases remain). No stray processes after FIXDONE. Read-only code review of question_records.py (show / names_mark / chapter_names / names_from / _name) and analysis_api.py load() + analysis_pdf.py Sheet.text/row/chapter table completed; all six invariants (a)-(f) hold. Screenshots on desktop and 390 px look clean: no clipped text, overlap or broken layout.

code_review_answers.a_no_write_on_noop_press: HOLDS. tejas/question_records.py:259-267 (show). The conditional filter {'show_chapters': {'$ne': True}} for On (with upsert=True) / {'show_chapters': True} for Off (no upsert), combined with DuplicateKeyError catch at line 263, guarantees modified_count==0 and upserted_id is None for an idempotent press, so `changed` stays False and neither the audit() call (line 267) nor the $set of show_at/show_by runs again. show_at is set only inside the conditional update so it cannot be bumped by a no-op.
code_review_answers.b_no_half_state_on_concurrent_presses: HOLDS. On+On concurrent: first wins the $ne:True filter and sets show_chapters=True; second's filter no longer matches, upsert=True with same _id yields DuplicateKeyError which is caught (line 263) -> changed=False. Off+Off: both match show_chapters:True; first flips it, second modifies 0 (filter no longer True) -> changed=False. On+Off: last writer wins; each writer either sees modified_count==1 (legit flip, audit) or 0 (no-op); no partial document because $set is atomic and the doc only carries show_chapters/show_at/show_by. No 500 observed in suites; DuplicateKeyError handled.
code_review_answers.c_no_write_to_attempt_pack_set_ledger_sc: HOLDS. analysis_api.py:97-101 (load): names applied only to in-memory `q['topic']` of the questions list that is zlib-compressed into the analysis cache doc (line 115). Nothing is written to tejas_attempts / tejas_sets / tejas_packs / ledger / score. score_attempt is called on `graded` (line 96) before the topic label is applied, so even the cached score is independent of the switch.
code_review_answers.d_cache_mark_identical_when_off: HOLDS. names_mark returns '' when show_chapters is falsy (question_records.py:278). analysis_api.py:90 then does `mark = [...] + (['jod:' + jod] if jod else [])`, i.e. an empty jod DOES NOT append any 'jod:' element, so the mark list is byte-identical to the pre-C1b mark. Cached rows written before C1b remain hits.
code_review_answers.e_practice_or_chapterwise_attempt_untouc: HOLDS. analysis_api.py:89 guards with `if a.get('series_id')`. A practice / chapter-wise attempt has no series_id -> jod='' -> no chapter_names call, no topic relabel, mark unchanged.
code_review_answers.f_pdf_prints_chapter_name_as_plain_text: HOLDS. analysis_pdf.py Sheet.row (107-116) renders cells via self.text; Sheet.text (55-63) uses MuPDF insert_text for latin-1 (no HTML parsing) and insert_htmlbox with html.escape(s) for non-latin1 (Hindi) names. Chapter-table row at line 349 and weak-chapter bar at 346-347 feed c['name']/g['name'] into these routines. No raw HTML injection possible; output is plain text.

critical_code_review_comments: question_records.show() correctly handles idempotent presses via a conditional filter + DuplicateKeyError catch; no audit/show_at churn on no-ops (invariant verified in question_names_edge258 pass).
analysis_api.load() mark concatenation only adds 'jod:<hash>' when the switch is On; empty jod does not perturb pre-C1b cache keys. Good.
The C1b label is applied strictly in-memory on cached analysis questions; score_attempt runs before the overlay. Clean separation.
analysis_pdf.Sheet.text uses html.escape for the rich-text fallback path, so chapter names containing HTML-like characters render as literal text in the PDF. No injection surface.
test_credentials: Not used. Each isolated suite creates its own owner/reviewer/student inside a disposable tejas_isolated_* DB (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md top block).
seed_data_creation: None in the real DB. Each suite creates and drops its own tejas_isolated_* DB.
